title: On Kinetic Optimal Probability Paths for Generative Models
tldr_zh: Gaussian 路径族动能只经一维数据分离函数依赖数据；n/sqrt(d)->0 时 Cond-OT 线性路径渐近动能最优
tldr_en: Kinetic energy of affine Gaussian paths depends on data only via a 1-D separation function; Cond-OT linear path is asymptotically kinetic optimal as n/sqrt(d) -> 0.
key_numbers: int_0^inf |1 - lambda(s)| ds <= 3n/sqrt(d) for any normalized finite dataset (Theorem 4.1, Eq. 34)
E_c - 6 M^2 n/sqrt(d) <= E <= E_c: KE converges to conditional KE, so Cond-OT is asymptotically kinetic optimal (Theorem 4.2, Corollary 4.3)
CIFAR-10 KE: DDPM 2.30, SI 1.30, FM Cond-OT 1.09, FM KO 1.08; FID-Adpt 7.4 / 7.5 / 6.9 / 6.1 (Table 1)
ImageNet-32 FM KO vs Cond-OT: NLL 3.57 vs 3.60, FID-Adpt 5.1 vs 5.0, NFE-Adpt 129 vs 145 (Table 1)
ImageNet-64 estimated lambda equals 1 for theta in [0.08, pi/2]; KO path practically identical to Cond-OT (Sec. 6.2, Fig. 1)
